info.title: Health Insurance Prometheus & CloudWatch Metrics Fetcher
info.description: Fetches performance metrics from Prometheus and CloudWatch for the Health Insurance platform

get.description: Retrieves metric data points from Prometheus / CloudWatch Metrics for the Health Insurance platform. Use when checking CPU usage, memory, error rates, latency, database connections, pod restarts, or request rates.

parameters.name: metric_name
parameters.description: The metric query name. Common values: pod_cpu_utilization, pod_memory_utilization, pod_restarts, deployment_replicas_unavailable, deployment_replicas_available

parameters.name: namespace
parameters.description: The Kubernetes namespace. Default is health-insurance.

parameters.name: hours_back
parameters.description: How many hours of data to retrieve.
